contracts: New allocation fields are optional on retained v1 parses; old source/event objects are not rewritten or backfilled.
The v1 return amount branch still requires quantity times original unit cost and forbids v2 allocation fields.
Unmarked stock payloads keep WEIGHTED_AVERAGE and omit receiptValuation entirely. Explicit return overrides require the source validator and v2 marker.
Invoice recovery retains its supplied proof; new marked allocations use v2. Unmarked legacy invoices retain their prior amount context and posting hash.
Recovery accepts old journal-bearing resolution events without requiring a newly introduced ledgerStatus field; no-journal outcomes require an explicit verified v2 zero proof.
Positive legacy credit and payment-balance behavior remains separate; a zero credit without valid v2 proof is rejected.
v1CompatibilityReview.limitation: Declaration equality and branch inspection do not replace fixture replay/hash assertions across the complete legacy path.

v2SemanticsAndResidualRisks.detail: Each draw uses remainingValue * requestedQuantity / remainingQuantity, rounded to cents; the final draw receives the exact residual. Reordering may assign a cent to a different operation but must conserve the total.

Invoice plus uninvoiced-return allocations share the acquisition pool; invoiced returns consume the retained invoice-funded claim pool. Exact reversals restore frozen values, not a recalculated value.
Stock movement, inventory level, return accounting and historical rebuild use the same verified allocated value, with explicit zero distinct from absent evidence.

A receipt-owned allocation that conflicts with current item/location value is rejected instead of clearing residual stock value. Mixed-source valuation reconciliation is not certified by these changes.
Unknown historical allocations are not silently repaired or relabeled v2; exact legacy proof remains necessary.

The initial narrow review found zero-credit creation/reversal bypassed period validation. Purchasing subsequently added independent source-date checks and focused closed/missing-period cases. Current execution must bind this corrected source. Resolving an already-recorded source-pending zero return remains a proof-only recovery with no new stock, credit or journal effect.
Exercise zero-commercial-total with positive claim through debit variance/credit claim, no supplier-balance effect, and exact reversal.
Only two amount checks are relaxed. Valid zero records prevent automatic re-tightening; no row deletion or history rewriting is an acceptable rollback.
